# Maximum Bed Contact Area

Maximum area of a single flat face on the build platform.

<figure markdown="span">
![Maximum Bed Contact Area: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-bed-contact-area-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Maximum Bed Contact Area: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-bed-contact-area-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Area of a flat face resting on the build platform, which affects warping.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Medium |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At most** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **Medium** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At most | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 5,000 mm² | 10,000 mm² | Not yet sourced |
| ABS | 2,500 mm² | 5,000 mm² | Not yet sourced |
| ASA | 2,500 mm² | 5,000 mm² | Not yet sourced |
| PA | 2,000 mm² | 4,000 mm² | Not yet sourced |
| PC | 2,000 mm² | 4,000 mm² | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, TPU (Flexible), PA-CF (Carbon Fiber).

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Bed contact area `{measured}` exceeds the recommended `{target}`. Large flat surfaces cool unevenly and can pull away from the bed at the corners. Consider adding mouse ears or splitting the face with a relief groove.
!!! failure "Error"

    Bed contact area `{measured}` exceeds the `{limit}` limit. A flat footprint this large will almost certainly warp as the part cools. Add a brim, use relief slots, or redesign to reduce unbroken bed contact.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At most" value |
